subject: Re: Pricing & env counts for private VPC — budget targets + unit econ
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@boxware.ai>; procurement@boxware.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Private VPC pricing follow-up — env counts, token targets, next steps

Hi Alice — great conversation today, thanks for walking us through Boxware's use case. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment moving into procurement/tech deep-dive:

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Expected steady-state token consumption: ~75M tokens / month (peak spikes to ~120M).
- Primary workloads: customer-facing chat + nightly batch embeddings for similarity index.
- Deployment footprint: 3 separate environments (prod, staging, sandbox/dev) + one separate analytics job cluster if we need isolated batch resources.
- Compliance: SOC2 in progress; data residency in the US required.

Pricing & unit-econ inputs we discussed:
- Boxware target total monthly spend: around $35k–$45k (all-in: license + support + usage).
- Unit cost target: looking for a committed unit near $900–$1,200 per 1M generation tokens (we discussed net blended pricing once license is applied).
- Licensing model you preferred: a private VPC annual license + committed token bucket. We discussed a few variants (term + lower unit price vs higher unit price + lightweight license).

Environment / ops notes:
- You confirmed 3 envs + the batch cluster; we’ll treat the batch cluster as an optional extra environment for sizing/billing.
- Support: you mentioned wanting 24x7 Enterprise support and an SLA for latency on the prod environment.

Attachments: I’m including the pricing calculator and my notes from the discovery call (priv_vpc_pricing_calculator.xlsx, 20261130-discovery-notes.pdf) — these have the assumptions we used below.

Assumptions I used in the calc (for clarity):
- Committed tokens: 60M/mo with 25% burst buffer.
- License fee: annual prepaid license amortized monthly in the calculator.
- Support tier: Enterprise (24x7) included as a line item.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You share any procurement PO template or standard terms we should align to (procurement@boxware.ai).
2) We'll schedule a technical deep-dive with infra (30–45m) to validate env topology and KV/cache needs (targeting Wed Dec 8).
3) Redwood will produce two written options: (A) 12-month license + committed tokens (lower $/1M); (B) no-term license + higher $/1M but no prepayment. We’ll include the environment count impact.

If that lines up with your expectation, I’ll send calendar invites for the tech deep-dive and share an initial price range by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Park <alice@boxware.ai>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing follow-up — env counts, token targets, next steps

On Tue, 01 Dec 2026 at 16:20 Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alice — great conversation today, thanks for walking us through Boxware's use case. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment moving into procurement/tech deep-dive:
> 
> Summary of what we heard on the call:
> - Expected steady-state token consumption: ~75M tokens / month (peak spikes to ~120M).

Thanks Hannah — that summary is accurate. A few clarifications and our asks: 

1) Confirmed monthly consumption: planning for 75M nominal, but budget needs to absorb spikes; procurement wants clear committed vs overage rates.
2) Budget target: our finance sponsor has pushed for an all-in figure of $40k/month (doesn't have to be exact today, but that's the sizing threshold).
3) Unit price target: our engineering lead asked whether you can get us in the neighborhood of $1,000 per 1M tokens after committed discounts (we realize license fees change the blended rate).
4) Support: we want Enterprise (24x7) support and a 99.9% uptime commitment for prod.
5) Environments: confirmed 3 envs + batch cluster. If you can bundle the batch cluster as an add-on rather than a charged full env that helps procurement.

Procurement timeline: we are hoping to finalize a vendor and get an initial PO by mid-December. Our procurement lead (procurement@boxware.ai) is included on this thread and can take contract redlines.

Can you send the two options you mentioned and a sample term sheet with amortized monthly pricing so we can show finance? Also please include what the ramp / true-up process looks like if our tokens exceed the committed bucket during spikes.

Best,
Alice
--
Alice Park
Head of Platform
Boxware AI
alice@boxware.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Private VPC pricing follow-up — env counts, token targets, next steps

Hannah / Marissa — quick internal note on pricing posture before we send to Boxware: 

Recommendation:
- Offer Option A (12-month license + 60M committed tokens) with a blended target of $850–$950 per 1M tokens after license amortization. License to be prepaid annually (we can amortize for presentation).
- Option B (no-term, month-to-month access) at ~$1,350 per 1M tokens with Enterprise support add-on priced separately.
- Environment bundling: include Prod+Staging as part of baseline. Treat Sandbox/dev as included for dev purposes, bundle batch cluster as a paid add-on at a reduced rate (50% of a full environment). That maps to Boxware's ask to keep batch as an add-on.
- Support: include Enterprise support in Option A; in Option B let support be add-on to keep headline lower.

Rationale: A is designed to hit Boxware's $40k/mo all-in target when positioned with a modest license fee (~$120k/yr amortized) and 60M committed tokens; B preserves flexibility but protects unit economics for Redwood.

Next action: Hannah, if you can present both options with line-item monthly amortization, I’ll draft the commercial terms and the internal discount approvals.

Ben
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@boxware.ai>, procurement@boxware.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing follow-up — env counts, token targets, next steps

Alice / procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Ben's note, attached is a two-option summary (see priv_vpc_pricing_calculator.xlsx) that shows monthly amortization and blended $/1M token math side-by-side. High level: 

- Option A (recommended): 12-month prepaid license + 60M committed tokens — blended ~ $900 / 1M tokens (amortized) — estimated all-in ~$38k/mo including Enterprise support and the baseline envs.
- Option B: month-to-month, no prepay — ~$1,350 / 1M tokens — Enterprise support optional add-on (pricing shown).

We’ve priced the batch cluster as an optional add-on at 50% of a full environment, per your ask. The calculator also includes a straightforward true-up policy: overage billed at 1.2x committed unit price and we’ll allow one mid-term true-up conversation for term upgrades.

Next steps I’m proposing now:
1) Tech deep-dive (30–45m) to validate topology and network requirements — Wed Dec 8, 11:00am PT. I’ll send the calendar invite.
2) Procurement: if you can send your PO template and any standard security addenda by EOD Mon Dec 7 we’ll feed that into the contract draft.
3) If Boxware is comfortable with Option A, Ben will prepare the commercial term sheet and I’ll loop legal for a first pass.

Would you like us to include a 60-day pilot clause (reduced committed tokens for month 1–2) to help you ramp? Happy to include it as an optional row in the calc.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Regards,
Hannah
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
